outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured microscopy images (micrographs), not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows scatter/line plots of normalized intensity vs time where each measured time point is plotted as an individual dot (red squares/green dots) rather than as a summary bar or single averaged curve, with fitted model lines overlaid. The insets show averaged early time-point responses with error bars, but the main plots already display the individual raw data points, satisfying the requirement.
